mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and ototoxic; aminoglycosides combined with beta-lactams increase risk of acute kidney injury and hearing loss through synergistic renal and eighth cranial nerve damage.
action: Monitor renal function (baseline and 2-3 times weekly), auditory function, and serum creatinine; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative therapy if possible or use lowest effective doses with extended dosing intervals.
